Despite being "fragrance free", meaning no additional ADDED fragrance, this serum has a strong and very unpleasant smell that does not dissipate over time. For those sensitive to fragrance - from whatever source - this is disappointing as it makes this serum unusable. Naturium should indicate when one or more ingredients imparts a noticeable smell (and there seem to be more Naturium products lately that do) -- regardless of the source of the smell - and make this information clear in the product description. Otherwise, it makes a purchase such as my purchase of this serum - a complete waste as I had to toss it. Note that "fragrance" can come from any of the ingredients even when it isn't specifically added to impart a fragrance. Currently, Naturium's statement that a product is "fragrance free" is meaningless.
